title: 石油工程师学会实践社区的虚拟成员：从原型到部署
summary: 本文介绍虚拟助手ATHENA的演进，用于支持石油天然气行业实践社区的知识捕获、检索和传播。评估显示，与最先进的RAG基线相比，ATHENA显著提高了75名专业人员在井规划任务中的生产力和绩效。技术改进包括多文档检索、答案验证支持和主动知识传播。ATHENA已集成到SPE研究门户并部署。
summary_en: This paper describes the evolution of ATHENA, a virtual assistant for knowledge management in the oil and gas industry. Evaluations show significant improvements in productivity and performance over a RAG baseline. Enhancements include multi-document retrieval, answer validation, and proactive dissemination. ATHENA is integrated into the SPE Research Portal.
